properties.query:
WhoisFreaksThreat_CL
| extend ConfidenceScore = todouble(confidence)
| where isnotnull(ConfidenceScore) and ConfidenceScore >= 0.8
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by domain, threat_type
| project TimeGenerated, domain, threat_type, confidence, first_seen, last_seen, is_parked, matched_pivots
properties.description: Identifies high-confidence malware, phishing, and spam domains from WhoisFreaks threat feeds. The feed reports confidence as a decimal between 0 and 1; this rule alerts on domains with a confidence of 0.8 or higher.
properties.name: WhoisFreaks - high confidence threat domains
